test_modes.name: Link/compliance test automation
test_modes.purpose: DPCD TEST_* registers drive defined link rates, lane counts, and test patterns for a compliance tester.

test_modes.name: PHY test patterns (TPS1..TPS4)
test_modes.purpose: Drive defined training/test patterns to characterize the embedded Main Link eye.

test_modes.name: AUX loopback / read-write
test_modes.purpose: Exercise the AUX channel and DPCD (incl. eDP block) independently of the Main Link.

test_modes.name: PSR entry/exit test
test_modes.purpose: Exercise Panel Self Refresh entry, self-refresh, and exit with the RFB.

test_modes.name: Backlight control test
test_modes.purpose: Exercise backlight brightness over AUX and the PWM generator.

spec_provided_observability.name: DPCD status registers
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Read LANE0_1_STATUS / LANE2_3_STATUS / LANE_ALIGN_STATUS_UPDATED for CR_DONE / CHANNEL_EQ_DONE / SYMBOL_LOCKED / INTERLANE_ALIGN_DONE per lane over AUX.

spec_provided_observability.name: eDP_CONFIGURATION_CAP / eDP_GENERAL_CAP
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Read ASSR / Fast-Link-Training / PSR / backlight capabilities.

spec_provided_observability.name: PSR_STATUS
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Read the panel's Panel-Self-Refresh state (idle / entry / self-refresh / exit).

spec_provided_observability.name: ADJUST_REQUEST
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Panel reports the requested voltage swing / pre-emphasis per lane during training.

spec_provided_observability.name: Device Service IRQ Vector
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Identifies the source of an IRQ_HPD (link-status change, PSR event, sink-specific).

spec_provided_observability.name: HPD / IRQ_HPD
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Presence and short-pulse event signaling to the Source.

error_detection_mechanisms: Per-lane training status (CR_DONE / CHANNEL_EQ_DONE / SYMBOL_LOCKED) detects loss of lock.
8b/10b disparity / invalid-symbol detection on the Main Link.
AUX reply NACK/DEFER and CRC on AUX transactions detect management errors.
Fast Link Training failure detection -> fall back to full CR/EQ.

interrupt_or_event_sources.trigger: Panel presence detected by the Sink.
Link-status change, PSR event, or sink event — Source re-reads DPCD.
CR/EQ status clears during ACTIVE; re-train.

notes: eDP's protocol-level test/debug surface is the AUX channel + DPCD (status, ADJUST_REQUEST, Device Service IRQ Vector, the eDP-specific block with PSR_STATUS / backlight, TEST_* automation) plus the Main-Link training/test patterns. Chip-level JTAG/scan/BIST remain Source / panel-TCON silicon concerns; conformance is established by the VESA eDP / DisplayPort Compliance Test Specification (CTS).
